label: stage-pass21-native-consolidated
executionMode: Eleven successful sequential128MiB cases retained; only Shepherds Glen rerun once in an authorized isolated64MiB/GC diagnostic case. This aggregation does not rerun rendering or count interrupted attempts as successes.

method.renderer: Actual FightEngine.update/render and the original native Canvas drawImage. Each stage is selected through its normal stage descriptor.
method.inputs: Only registered InputState keydown/keyup callbacks receive synthetic native events. No actor position, facing, health, phase, presentation or clock is assigned.
method.decoder: PNG encoding normalized in memory for native decoding; every decoded RGBA byte is compared before/after.
method.scope: Existing fighters exercise initial stage composition, movement in both directions, release to idle, exact planes, live parallax and cache admission.

limits: Native Canvas does not exercise Chromium, DOM/CSS, HTTP, actual browser keyboard delivery or service workers.
No new fighter pose, attack, contact, guard, finisher, stage hazard, original timing or 1:1 artistic fidelity is certified.
Two static stage planes and their runtime parallax do not constitute a new source animation.

harnessVariants.changes: Diagnostic RSS logs only; original engine logic, assertions and native decoder unchanged.
Explicit garbage collection after Sharp decoding and before native preflight, plus finer RSS logs; engine logic, assertions and actor state unchanged.

initialAttempt.evidenceSource: Exit code137 reported by root for its actual grouped launch; directory contents observed and preserved by this QA agent. No terminal report or success inferred.

isolatedDiagnostic.causality: Heap option and exec attachment interval changed together. Success does not isolate one cause for previous SIGKILL.

priorAttemptNote: Grouped exit137, initial single-process SIGKILL and Shepherds Glen128MiB SIGKILL remain failed/interrupted and archived separately. The successful isolated Old Silent Hill diagnostic is also excluded from the twelve selected cases and assertion totals.
causalityLimit: Heap limits, GC policy, tool attachment interval and concurrent workload changed across attempts. The prior SIGKILL cause is not isolated to a single variable.
